reviews.title: Great but not free
reviews.text: Great app but rewrites a subscription that to me is not worth what they are asking.

reviews.title: Not even opening
reviews.text: I just downloaded and can't seem to use it; it keeps crashing and crashing and doesn't even let me report the issue. Why? How can I give it more than 1 star if there isn't even a way for me to report it's mlfunction? Where should I report it instead of leaving a bad review?

reviews.title: Fine for daily goals but that’s it
reviews.text: It’s fine—not great—for getting yourself to hit daily goals. But for anything else it’s awful. If you only want to do something a few times a week, find another app. This one is clearly not designed for that

reviews.title: What a waste
reviews.text: I bought the paid version so I could try to really get into goal making. But it’s such a waste of money. This app is more annoying than anything, just constant reminders than at actual times that are constructive. I sincerely regret having bought the paid version of this app. I would have been better off had I known, then I just wouldn’t have downloaded in the first place. Not a fan. Also, not a great app for neurodivergent types.

reviews.title: in app purchases
reviews.text: there are in app purchases that basically limit everything

reviews.title: Won’t open
reviews.text: Just downloaded app on iPad Pro. When I try to open, app immediately freezes and quits. No way to contact support without having app open.

reviews.title: Streaks don’t transfer to new devices
reviews.text: Been using this app for years and when I got a new iPhone, all my history is gone, even when I “synced” my trackers. Really disappointed 😭.

reviews.title: The free version isn’t useful
reviews.text: The free version is not useful, you only can add 3 goals.
